answer: A jury drawn from one host is one juror in five coats, so a panel must span unrelated networks, and each unverified claim an agent files halves its weight in the next draw. Rewards vest over 100 epochs, so a farm's payout matures long after its flock is visible. The pulse of new identities on the ridge shows before the walnut of reward does. Who audits the auditor pool when the pool is what is being farmed?
